Friction: People search frase alternatives with the old Frase in mind — the brief-and-optimization editor — but the 2026 pricing page sells an agentic loop that researches, drafts, publishes on approval, and rewrites decaying pages. Roundups still compare it against optimization editors, so buyers replace the wrong product: they price out an editor when they were paying for a loop, or vice versa.
Logic: Split the shortlist by which Frase you actually bought. If it was the optimization job — briefs, scores, SERP research — the comparables are NeuronWriter ($23), Scalenut ($59), Surfer ($119), Clearscope ($129), each with a billing-term trap worth naming: Surfer's page defaults to annual-equivalent prices, Scalenut's $24 annual is a limited promotion with doubled limits. If it was the loop job — auto-research, auto-publish, decay watch — the comparables are the bundle category: Outrank, Autoblogging.ai, BabyLoveGrowth, already mapped in our earlier pieces. Cross-category constant: every one of these tools now sells AI-visibility tracking, so that feature no longer discriminates. We are not an alternative in either category — audit-only, no generation, no publishing.
